title: Exponential lifting for a right fibration and a right-anodyne map
statement:
Use simplicial sets, horns and internal functor simplicial sets of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and trivial Kan fibrations of [def-weil-pbc-trivial-kan-fibration]. A right fibration has the right lifting property against $\Lambda_j^m\hookrightarrow\Delta^m$ for $m\geq1$ and $0<j\leq m$. Right anodyne maps form the closure of these horn inclusions and all isomorphisms under pushouts, transfinite compositions and retracts. Let $q:E\to S$ be a right fibration of arbitrary small simplicial sets, and let $i:A\hookrightarrow B$ be right anodyne. The map
$$\rho:\operatorname{Fun}(B,E)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Fun}(B,S)\times_{\operatorname{Fun}(A,S)}\operatorname{Fun}(A,E),\qquad u\longmapsto(q\circ u,u\circ i),$$
is a trivial Kan fibration. No quasicategory assumption on $E$ or $S$ is imposed.
